account_sid.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created User Defined Message.

call_sid.description: The SID of the [Call](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource) the User Defined Message is associated with.

sid.description: The SID that uniquely identifies this User Defined Message.

date_created.description: The date that this User Defined Message was created, given in RFC 2822 format.
